title: Italian Restaurant Menu
brief:
Dinner menu for a modern Italian fine-dining room — antipasti, primi, secondi, contorni and dolci, with the cocktail and cellar list beside them. The gallery is the dish photography: plated courses, drinks and bottles shot close and low-key on dark grounds, plus one drawn botanical paper texture to lay type over.

The spreads should read expensive and calm — warm cream paper, deep espresso ink, generous margins, one dish to a block, nothing crowded.
